# Getting Help

| I want to… | Go to |
|---|---|
| Install or set up DuoHacker | [Installation guide](../docs/installation.md) |
| Find a quick answer | [FAQ](../docs/faq.md) |
| Ask a question or chat with the community | [Discord](https://duohacker.io.vn/discord) |
| Watch setup guides | [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@duohacker-hack-cheat) |
| Report a bug | [Bug report](https://github.com/DuoHacker/DuoHacker/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) |
| Suggest a feature | [Feature request](https://github.com/DuoHacker/DuoHacker/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) |
| Report a security problem | [Security Policy](SECURITY.md) (do not use a public issue) |

Please do not post your Duolingo password, JWT token or cookies anywhere, including in issues and on Discord.
